key_insight: DV-Flow reframes deterministic forecasting as a parallel velocity in flow matching, making probabilistic time-series prediction more stable to train while preserving uncertainty modeling.
engineering_relevance: This gives engineers a more reliable way to combine point forecasts and generative uncertainty estimates in operational forecasting systems.
method: Use a unified flow-matching objective for probabilistic forecasting.
Inject the deterministic predictor as an additional velocity component, not as the transport endpoint.
Enable end-to-end optimization while subsuming several prior formulations as special cases.
evidence_signal: The paper reports extensive experiments on six real-world datasets, where DV-Flow consistently outperforms strong baselines in probabilistic forecasting.
watch_item: The approach still depends on careful implementation of the coupled flow-matching setup and may require tuning to avoid instability in large or complex time-series models.
paper_title: Deterministic Prediction as Global Velocity: Flow Matching for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecast
